purpose: Product-evidence graduation gate for Chengzhu Conversation v2. Numerical quality thresholds, min_n values and profile floors remain unchanged from policy v6. Policy v7 closes a longitudinal-cohort ambiguity: one qualifying cross-session Conversation Space must bind to exactly one pseudonymous user_ref and contain at least the frozen minimum authorized Sessions for that same user; mixed-user Spaces fail closed and cannot manufacture continuity.
change_control: Numerical quality thresholds, every min_n number, required profile floors, the >=3 Sessions cross-session Space minimum, label-source rules and UNIQUE_EVENT_PER_METRIC sample unit are unchanged from policy v6. Policy v7 is a pre-pilot longitudinal-evidence correction: one Space must bind to one pseudonymous user_ref across selected Sessions. Do not lower thresholds/floors, broaden populations, mix users inside one continuity Space, duplicate one event across reviewers/sources, mix manual-lab events, count forced silence, or weaken a quality/cohort rule merely to make a failing pilot pass.

label_source_policy.LOCAL_IN_PRODUCT_EXPLICIT_SELF_REPORT: Explicit post-session labels entered in Chengzhu on the local device. Valid for user-perception/outcome measures only where a metric explicitly allows it; not verified identity proof.
label_source_policy.INDEPENDENT_HUMAN_REVIEW: Explicit human review performed independently from the in-product self-report surface under the human-label protocol.
label_source_policy.UNSPECIFIED: Never accepted for stable-promotion metric thresholds.

useful_silence_rate.interpretation: Measures whether the automatic Guidance Arbiter correctly chose not to interrupt; policy/profile/provenance hard blocks are audit evidence, not Useful Silence samples.

decision_commitment_state_precision.denominator: Rows whose immutable predicted_type is Decision, Commitment, or Task and that have independent actual_type + actual_state labels.

sample_unit.interpretation: Each product event can contribute at most one resolved observation to a given Stable metric. Multiple reviewer/source annotations of the same event+metric must be resolved or selected outside the Stable aggregate; they cannot increase min_n.
